protocol.primary_population: source errors whose frozen Level 6.19 Memory Probe is correct
protocol.common_dose: per-example context L2 induced by Probe top-four 4x odds

conditions.finite_shared_l2: Level 6.19.2 gradient attention tilt with one shared dose
conditions.finite_head_budget_l2: eight-dimensional nonnegative finite-softmax Oracle, initialized from uniform and linearized NNLS allocations, optimized on exact finite context and rematched to total L2
conditions.signed_affine_l2: minimum-coefficient zero-sum signed per-head value mixture projecting the deployed context gradient into the full frozen value/output tangent span
conditions.head_tomography: eight equal-L2 one-head projections and eight equal-L2 leave-one-head-out projections

decision_rule.head_budget_closure: finite head-budget recovery >= threshold and positive head-budget versus shared-dose margin contrast at p < 0.05
decision_rule.signed_closure: signed recovery >= threshold and every signed-direction contrast positive with Holm p < 0.05
decision_rule.positive_control: unrestricted equal-L2 context margin gain positive at p < 0.05

protocol.interpretation: all optimized directions use labels and are mechanistic, not deployable

numerical_audit.intervention: explicit updated-minus-source FP32 attention delta added to exact native source context

diagnosis.registered_next_boundary: Stop; repair the unrestricted context positive control.
